iisConfigurationReference.source: IIS Application Request Routing (ARR) 3.0 arr_schema.xml, webfarm.xml and Microsoft Learn

section.source: ARR (Application Request Routing) schema + Microsoft Learn

option.name: enabled
option.description: Turns on ARR proxy functionality for this server so routing rules can forward requests.

option.name: passConnectionCloseHeader
option.description: Forwards the backend Connection: close header to the client instead of keeping the client connection open.

option.name: resetLbCounters
option.description: Resets load-balancing counters when the server farm configuration changes.

option.name: passServerHeader
option.description: How the Server response header is handled: Replace, Remove or PassThrough from the backend.

option.name: httpVersion
option.description: HTTP version used toward backend servers: Http10, Http11 or PassThrough (same as the client request).

option.name: keepAlive
option.description: Keeps connections to backend servers open for reuse by later requests.

option.name: timeout
option.description: Maximum time ARR waits for a backend response before returning an error to the client.

option.name: connectTimeout
option.description: Time allowed to connect to a backend server. 00:00:00 means the overall timeout value is used.

option.name: preserveHostHeader
option.description: Sends the client's original Host header to the backend instead of the backend server name.

option.name: preserveDateHeader
option.description: Keeps the backend Date response header instead of letting ARR generate a new one.

option.name: reverseRewriteHostInResponseHeaders
option.description: Rewrites backend host names in Location, Content-Location and Set-Cookie headers back to the ARR host name.

option.name: xForwardedByHeaderName
option.description: Name of the header that identifies the ARR server forwarding the request.

option.name: xForwardedByHeader
option.description: Value placed in the forwarded-by header. Empty means no value is sent.

option.name: xForwardedForHeaderName
option.description: Name of the header that carries the original client IP address to the backend.

option.name: includePortInXForwardedFor
option.description: Appends the client source port to the IP address in the X-Forwarded-For header.

option.name: arrResponseHeader
option.description: Adds the X-Powered-By: ARR response header to responses routed through ARR.

option.name: sslHeaderName
option.description: Name of the header that tells the backend the client request used SSL.

option.name: clientCertHeaderName
option.description: Name of the header that passes the client certificate to the backend.

option.name: logGuidName
option.description: Name of the response header that carries the ARR log correlation ID.

option.name: logCacheHitName
option.description: Name of the response header that reports whether the ARR cache served the request.

option.name: maxForwards
option.description: Maximum number of times a request with Max-Forwards may be forwarded through proxies.

option.name: minResponseBuffer
option.description: Minimum response buffer size in bytes that ARR fills before sending data to the client.

option.name: responseBufferLimit
option.description: Maximum response buffer size in bytes ARR uses per request. 0 disables response buffering.

option.name: maxResponseHeaderSize
option.description: Largest backend response header size in bytes that ARR accepts.

option.name: proxy
option.description: Host name of an upstream proxy server to chain through. Empty means no chained proxy.

option.name: proxyBypass
option.description: Semicolon-separated host list that bypasses the chained proxy.

option.name: stealthMode
option.description: Hides ARR and backend identifying details in forwarded requests and responses.

option.name: clientCertFileName
option.description: Path to a client certificate file ARR presents to backend servers when they require one.

option.name: clientCertPassword
option.description: Encrypted password for the backend client certificate file.

option.name: clientCertHash
option.description: Thumbprint of the client certificate ARR presents to backend servers.

option.name: bufferChunkedResponses
option.description: Buffers chunked backend responses before sending them to the client.

option.name: enabled
option.description: Enables the ARR disk cache for cacheable responses.

option.name: requestConsolidationEnabled
option.description: Sends one backend request for simultaneous requests for the same uncached content.

option.name: requestConsolidationTimeout
option.description: How long consolidated requests wait for the first backend response (fractional seconds).

option.name: queryStringHandling
option.description: How query strings affect caching: Ignore, NoCaching, Accept or Preserve.

option.name: validationInterval
option.description: How long cached content is served before ARR revalidates it with the backend server.

section.source: ARR (Application Request Routing) schema + Microsoft Learn

option.name: allowedAcceptEncoding
option.description: Accept-Encoding values ARR will cache. Other encodings are not stored.

option.name: byteRangeSegmentSize
option.description: Size in KB of the segments ARR uses to cache byte-range requests.

option.name: scavengerInterval
option.description: How often the cache scavenger checks disk usage and removes old content.

option.name: lowWatermark
option.description: Percentage of cache quota the scavenger reduces usage to once it starts cleaning.

option.name: highWatermark
option.description: Percentage of cache quota that triggers the scavenger to start cleaning.

option.name: path
option.description: Folder on a drive used to store cached content.

option.name: maxUsage
option.description: Maximum disk space in MB that ARR may use at this cache location.

option.name: path
option.description: Shared folder used for a cache shared between several ARR servers.

option.name: enabled
option.description: Monitors disk queue length and skips busy cache drives.

option.name: diskQueueLengthLowWatermark
option.description: Disk queue length below which a cache drive is used again.

option.name: diskQueueLengthHighWatermark
option.description: Disk queue length above which a cache drive is skipped.

option.name: enabled
option.description: Compresses cached content on disk for the configured MIME types.

option.name: level
option.description: Compression level for cached content: 0 is none, 10 is highest and uses the most CPU.

option.name: mimeType
option.description: MIME type pattern, such as text/*, whose cached content is compressed.

option.name: enabled
option.description: Whether cached content of this MIME type is compressed.

section.source: ARR (Application Request Routing) schema + Microsoft Learn

option.name: onDemandHealthCheck
option.description: Runs a health check for a server only when it receives a request, not on a timer.

option.name: name
option.description: Host affinity provider, such as Microsoft.Web.Arr.HostNameRoundRobin or HostNameMemory.

option.name: name
option.description: Unique name of the server farm. Routing rules refer to it as the action target.

option.name: enabled
option.description: Whether the server farm accepts routed requests.

option.name: serverAutoStart
option.description: Automatically brings servers online when they are added to the farm.

option.name: resetLbCounters
option.description: Resets the farm's load-balancing counters when its configuration changes.

option.name: passConnectionCloseHeader
option.description: Forwards the backend Connection: close header to the client for this farm.

option.name: passServerHeader
option.description: How the Server response header is handled for this farm: Replace, Remove or PassThrough.

option.name: autoEnableAgent
option.description: Web Farm Framework: automatically installs and enables the agent on farm servers.

option.name: adminUserName
option.description: Web Farm Framework: administrator account used to manage the farm servers.

option.name: adminPassword
option.description: Web Farm Framework: encrypted password of the farm administrator account.

option.name: minimumServers
option.description: Web Farm Framework: minimum number of servers that must stay available in the farm.

option.name: agentUrl
option.description: Web Farm Framework: URL template of the agent service on each server ({0} is the server address).

option.name: restartServerOnConfigurationChange
option.description: Web Farm Framework: restarts servers after a configuration change that needs a restart.

option.name: restartServerIfReady
option.description: Web Farm Framework: restarts a server only when it is ready to leave rotation.

option.name: primaryServer
option.description: Web Farm Framework: address of the primary server that provisions the other servers.

option.name: loadBalancerProvider
option.description: Web Farm Framework: load balancer provider used by the farm. Arr is the built-in ARR provider.

option.name: periodicRuntimeData
option.description: Web Farm Framework: how often runtime data is collected from farm servers.

option.name: enableRuntimeData
option.description: Web Farm Framework: collects runtime data such as server state from farm servers.

option.name: maximumStoppedServers
option.description: Web Farm Framework: maximum number of servers that may be stopped at the same time.

option.name: agentRetryTime
option.description: Web Farm Framework: how long to wait before retrying communication with an agent.

option.name: frontEndUrl
option.description: Web Farm Framework: public URL of the farm front end.

option.name: address
option.description: Host name or IP address of a backend server in the farm.

option.name: enabled
option.description: Whether this backend server receives routed requests.

option.name: hostName
option.description: Host name ARR uses to identify this server instead of its address.

option.name: weight
option.description: Relative load share of this server. Higher weights receive more requests.

option.name: httpPort
option.description: HTTP port on the backend server that ARR sends requests to.

option.name: httpsPort
option.description: HTTPS port on the backend server that ARR sends SSL requests to.

option.name: healthCheckAlternateHostName
option.description: Host name used in health check requests to this server instead of the farm default.

option.name: healthCheckAlternatePort
option.description: Port used for health checks of this server. 0 uses the regular HTTP port.

option.name: httpVersion
option.description: HTTP version toward farm servers: Http10, Http11 or PassThrough (same as the client request).

option.name: keepAlive
option.description: Keeps connections to farm servers open for reuse by later requests.

option.name: timeout
option.description: Time ARR waits for a farm server response before failing the request. Common cause of 502.3 errors.

option.name: connectTimeout
option.description: Time allowed to connect to a farm server. 00:00:00 means the overall timeout value is used.

option.name: preserveHostHeader
option.description: Sends the client's original Host header to farm servers instead of the server address.

option.name: preserveDateHeader
option.description: Keeps the backend Date response header instead of letting ARR generate a new one.

option.name: alternateHostName
option.description: Host name sent to farm servers in the Host header instead of the client's value.

option.name: reverseRewriteHostInResponseHeaders
option.description: Rewrites farm server host names in Location, Content-Location and Set-Cookie headers to the ARR host name.

option.name: xForwardedByHeaderName
option.description: Name of the header that identifies the ARR server forwarding the request.

option.name: xForwardedByHeader
option.description: Value placed in the forwarded-by header. Empty means no value is sent.

option.name: xForwardedForHeaderName
option.description: Name of the header that carries the original client IP address to farm servers.

option.name: includePortInXForwardedFor
option.description: Appends the client source port to the IP address in the X-Forwarded-For header.

option.name: arrResponseHeader
option.description: Adds the X-Powered-By: ARR response header to responses routed through this farm.

option.name: sslHeaderName
option.description: Name of the header that tells farm servers the client request used SSL.

option.name: clientCertHeaderName
option.description: Name of the header that passes the client certificate to farm servers.

option.name: logGuidName
option.description: Name of the response header that carries the ARR log correlation ID.

option.name: logCacheHitName
option.description: Name of the response header that reports whether the ARR cache served the request.

option.name: maxForwards
option.description: Maximum number of times a request with Max-Forwards may be forwarded through proxies.

option.name: minResponseBuffer
option.description: Minimum response buffer size in bytes that ARR fills before sending data to the client.

option.name: responseBufferLimit
option.description: Maximum response buffer size in bytes ARR uses per request. 0 disables response buffering.

option.name: maxResponseHeaderSize
option.description: Largest farm server response header size in bytes that ARR accepts.

option.name: proxy
option.description: Host name of an upstream proxy server to chain through. Empty means no chained proxy.

option.name: proxyBypass
option.description: Semicolon-separated host list that bypasses the chained proxy.

option.name: stealthMode
option.description: Hides ARR and farm server identifying details in forwarded requests and responses.

option.name: clientCertFileName
option.description: Path to a client certificate file ARR presents to farm servers when they require one.

option.name: clientCertPassword
option.description: Encrypted password for the farm client certificate file.

option.name: clientCertHash
option.description: Thumbprint of the client certificate ARR presents to farm servers.

option.name: bufferChunkedResponses
option.description: Buffers chunked farm server responses before sending them to the client.

option.name: enabled
option.description: Enables the ARR disk cache for responses from this farm.

option.name: requestConsolidationEnabled
option.description: Sends one backend request for simultaneous requests for the same uncached content.

option.name: requestConsolidationTimeout
option.description: How long consolidated requests wait for the first backend response (fractional seconds).

option.name: queryStringHandling
option.description: How query strings affect caching: Ignore, NoCaching, Accept or Preserve.

option.name: validationInterval
option.description: How long cached content is served before ARR revalidates it with the farm server.

option.name: url
option.description: URL ARR requests on each server to test health. Empty means no URL test is performed.

option.name: retries
option.description: Number of times a health check is retried before the server is marked unhealthy.

option.name: interval
option.description: How often ARR sends the health check request to each server.

option.name: timeout
option.description: Time ARR waits for a health check response before counting it as failed.

option.name: connectTimeout
option.description: Time allowed to connect for a health check. 00:00:00 means the health check timeout is used.

option.name: fastFailure
option.description: Marks a server unhealthy at the first failed health check without waiting for retries.

option.name: statusCodeMatch
option.description: HTTP status codes or ranges that count as a healthy health check response.

option.name: responseMatch
option.description: Text the health check response body must contain. Case-sensitive. Empty means any body.

option.name: liveTrafficFailureCodes
option.description: Status codes or ranges from live traffic that count as server failures.

option.name: maxLiveTrafficFailures
option.description: Live traffic failures allowed within the failure period before a server is marked unhealthy.

option.name: liveTrafficFailurePeriod
option.description: Time window for counting live traffic failures. 00:00:00 disables live traffic health checks.

option.name: minServers
option.description: Minimum number of healthy servers ARR keeps in rotation even if checks fail.

option.name: useCookie
option.description: Client affinity: keeps a client on the same server using a cookie.

option.name: cookieName
option.description: Name of the client affinity cookie.

option.name: useHostName
option.description: Host name affinity: maps each host name to a specific server, for shared hosting.

option.name: hostCountersEnabled
option.description: Tracks per-host request counters used by host name affinity providers.

option.name: useServerProvider
option.description: Uses a server-side provider, instead of ARR's own data, to pick the server for a host name.

option.name: timeout
option.description: How long affinity mappings are kept after the last request. Default is 20 minutes.

option.name: useExternalCache
option.description: Stores host name affinity mappings in an external cache shared between ARR servers.

option.name: ignoreSubDomain
option.description: Treats sub-domains of a host name as the same host for host name affinity.

option.name: ignoreSubDomainClientAffinity
option.description: Shares the client affinity cookie across sub-domains of the same parent domain.

option.name: ignoreSubDomainFragmentDepth
option.description: Number of right-most domain parts kept when sub-domains are ignored (2 for example.com).

option.name: hostAffinityProvider
option.description: Provider that assigns host names to servers, such as HostNameRoundRobin or HostNameMemory.

option.name: serverProviderImage
option.description: Server-side provider image used when server provider affinity is enabled.

option.name: name
option.description: Host name that is mapped to specific servers for host name affinity.

option.name: servers
option.description: Number of servers assigned to this host name.

option.name: name
option.description: Alternate host name treated as the same host for affinity purposes.

option.name: algorithm
option.description: Load balancing method. ARR 3.0 supports WeightedRoundRobin and RequestHash; older values fall back to round robin.

option.name: leastResponseTimePeriod
option.description: Legacy period used for response time based balancing. Not used by WeightedRoundRobin.

option.name: hashServerVariable
option.description: Server variable whose value is hashed to pick a server when the algorithm is RequestHash. Case-sensitive.

option.name: queryStringNames
option.description: Query string names hashed to pick a server when the algorithm is RequestHash with the query string variable.

option.name: randomizeLBTies
option.description: Picks randomly among servers with equal load instead of always taking the first one.

option.name: acceptValidCertificateWhenKeyMismatch
option.description: Accepts a backend SSL certificate that chains to a trusted root even if its public key is not in the pinned list.

option.name: validCertificateChainFlags
option.description: Certificate chain policy flags used when validating backend SSL certificates against a key mismatch.

option.name: bytes
option.description: Pinned public key bytes of a backend SSL certificate.

option.name: algorithmOid
option.description: Object identifier of the pinned public key algorithm.

option.name: enabled
option.description: Web Farm Framework: automatically repairs servers that fall out of sync.

option.name: retryInterval
option.description: Web Farm Framework: wait between automatic repair attempts.

option.name: retryAttempts
option.description: Web Farm Framework: number of automatic repair attempts before giving up.

option.name: enabled
option.description: Web Farm Framework: uses a proxy server for provisioning downloads.

option.name: proxyaddress
option.description: Web Farm Framework: address of the proxy server used for provisioning downloads.

option.name: bypassOnLocal
option.description: Web Farm Framework: skips the proxy for local addresses.

option.name: userName
option.description: Web Farm Framework: user name used to authenticate to the proxy server.

option.name: password
option.description: Web Farm Framework: encrypted password used to authenticate to the proxy server.

option.name: address
option.description: Web Farm Framework: address that bypasses the proxy server.

option.name: stopOnInstall
option.description: Web Farm Framework: stops IIS services on a server while platform components are installed.

option.name: periodicSync
option.description: Web Farm Framework: how often platform components are synchronized from the primary server.

option.name: syncPlatformFromPrimary
option.description: Web Farm Framework: installs on secondary servers the platform components found on the primary server.

option.name: deepDependencyInstall
option.description: Web Farm Framework: also installs dependencies of platform components.

option.name: feedUrl
option.description: Web Farm Framework: Web Platform Installer feed used to find platform components.

option.name: url
option.description: Web Farm Framework: additional product feed URL used to find platform components.

option.name: productId
option.description: Web Farm Framework: product ID of a platform component to install on farm servers.

option.name: offlineWhileSync
option.description: Web Farm Framework: takes a server out of rotation while applications are synchronized to it.

option.name: syncWebServerFromPrimary
option.description: Web Farm Framework: also synchronizes web server settings from the primary server.

option.name: periodicSync
option.description: Web Farm Framework: how often applications are synchronized from the primary server.

option.name: name
option.description: Web Farm Framework: name of a synchronization skip rule.

option.name: enabled
option.description: Web Farm Framework: whether this synchronization skip rule is active.

option.name: skipDirective
option.description: Web Farm Framework: Web Deploy skip directive applied during synchronization.

option.name: providerName
option.description: Web Farm Framework: Web Deploy provider used for synchronization.

option.name: path
option.description: Web Farm Framework: path the synchronization provider acts on.

option.name: name
option.description: Web Farm Framework: name of a synchronization provider setting.

option.name: value
option.description: Web Farm Framework: value of a synchronization provider setting.

option.name: name
option.description: Web Farm Framework: name of a custom provider that has settings.

option.name: name
option.description: Web Farm Framework: name of a custom provider setting.

option.name: value
option.description: Web Farm Framework: value of a custom provider setting.

option.name: name
option.description: Web Farm Framework: unique name of a custom run provider.

option.name: friendlyName
option.description: Web Farm Framework: display name of a run provider.

option.name: description
option.description: Web Farm Framework: description of a run provider.

option.name: commandToRun
option.description: Web Farm Framework: command or script the run provider executes.

option.name: runRemote
option.description: Web Farm Framework: runs the command on the farm servers instead of the controller.

option.name: dependencies
option.description: Web Farm Framework: providers that must run before this one.

option.name: dependants
option.description: Web Farm Framework: providers that must run after this one.

option.name: retryAttempts
option.description: Web Farm Framework: number of times a failed run provider is retried.

option.name: retryInterval
option.description: Web Farm Framework: milliseconds to wait between run provider retries.

option.name: periodicRun
option.description: Web Farm Framework: interval for repeating the run provider. 00:00:00 runs it only on demand.

option.name: scriptType
option.description: Web Farm Framework: kind of script the run provider runs: command or powershell.

option.name: operationType
option.description: Web Farm Framework: whether the run provider acts on a single Server or the whole Webfarm.

option.name: name
option.description: Web Farm Framework: name of a run provider parameter.

option.name: type
option.description: Web Farm Framework: data type of a run provider parameter.

option.name: friendlyName
option.description: Web Farm Framework: display name of a run provider parameter.

option.name: description
option.description: Web Farm Framework: description of a run provider parameter.

option.name: defaultValue
option.description: Web Farm Framework: default value of a run provider parameter.
